# Cleretec Automotive

> Cleretec Automotive is a fully mobile mechanic based in Mildura, VIC, servicing the Sunraysia region — European specialist servicing (Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Volkswagen) through to general servicing for any make or model. Approved for digital service records across Mercedes-Benz, BMW Group and Jaguar Land Rover, so newer vehicles can be serviced without affecting the manufacturer warranty.

Cleretec brings a fully-equipped workshop to the customer's home or workplace — no shopfront, no drop-off, no waiting room. Genuine and OEM-spec parts, dealer-level diagnostics, and honest advice.

Call or text 08 7137 1441, or email service@cleretecautomotive.com.au.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cleretecautomotive.com.au/): Overview of Cleretec Automotive's mobile mechanic service, service area, and trust signals (manufacturer approval, genuine parts).
- [Services](https://cleretecautomotive.com.au/services.html): Full service list — European specialist servicing, general & logbook servicing, brakes & suspension, diagnostics & fault finding, batteries & electrical, fluids & filters.
- [Why Cleretec](https://cleretecautomotive.com.au/why-cleretec.html): What sets Cleretec apart — fully-equipped mobile workshop, genuine & OEM-spec parts, real diagnostics (borescope + dealer-level scan tools), manufacturer-approved digital service records.
- [The Work](https://cleretecautomotive.com.au/the-work.html): Photos of recent jobs completed across Mildura and Sunraysia, from AMG V8s to daily drivers.
- [Service Area](https://cleretecautomotive.com.au/service-area.html): Coverage — Mildura, Merbein, Red Cliffs, Irymple, Nichols Point, and across the NSW border to Buronga, Gol Gol and Wentworth.
- [Contact](https://cleretecautomotive.com.au/contact.html): Phone, text and email details to book a service.
